literal_meaning: চাকা (চাক্র বা গোলাকার বস্তু) এর দ্বিত্বশব্দ বা বহুবচন রূপ
figurative_meaning_en: Circular or round (referring to shapes or marks)
example_sentences_in_english: There are round marks on his body.
The fruit has circular imprints on it.
note: This idiom uses reduplication, a common feature in Bengali for emphasis on shape and repetition.
